reason: Checked src/sky_main.6502 sky_draw. Every path from .row to .next_row keeps X: .row stores X to sky_q and reads sky_rb,X; h0, rc_ok and ADC sky_rc,X only read it; sky_row (LDA/STA/EOR/SEC/ADC/ORA/TAY/LDA/RTS) never writes X; whole, part, the self-modified JMP into line8 and the unrolled LDA/STA/DEY lines, and the TYA/SEC/SBC/TAY/BPL tail use only A and Y. next_row is local to sky_draw's scope (sky_zero and sky.6502 have their own), entered only by BMI next_row and fall-through. Interrupts preserve X. sky_q is still written at .row, so any later reader sees the same value; exit state (X = sky_nq, flags, A, Y) is unchanged. Project rules: sky_main.6502 is hand-written (not generated, not in PROTECT/PROTECT_BYTES), not raster-timed, runs in main RAM touching only registers and zero page &E0 (no ROMSEL/ANDY/ACCCON dependence for this instruction). Net size 0: LDX zp removed (2 bytes) and EQUB 0,0 added after RTS inside the scope, unexecuted, so sky_img0 and everything after keep their addresses and the region's free space is unchanged. Saves LDX zp, 3 cycles each time next_row runs.
